state_policy.stateless: No SuccessfulCapabilityHistory prior and no SessionSchemaExposure filtering.
state_policy.cold_start: Fresh empty history and exposure objects per host scope; must match stateless candidate order and schema exposure.
state_policy.frozen_history: Load a predeclared successful-history checkpoint before scoring; scoring must not mutate it.
state_policy.session_exposure: Exposure state is created per user/session/role host scope and never shared across scopes.
state_policy.post_compaction: Host explicitly calls compacted(); the next required schema is eligible for reinjection.
